Run: `__RUN_TIMESTAMP__`

This experiment adds VLA thermal noise to 0012-399 and makes a natural-weight
dirty image. The input flags are preserved.

## Declared scenario

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---:|
| Input MS | `__SOURCE_MS__` |
| Representative frequency | __REPRESENTATIVE_FREQUENCY_GHZ__ GHz |
| Band / sampler | C / 8-bit |
| Antennas / cross baselines | __NANTENNAS__ / __NBASELINES__ |
| Integrations / exposure | __NINTEGRATIONS__ / __EXPOSURE_S__ s |
| Nominal on-source time | __ON_SOURCE_S__ s |
| Channels / Stokes-I products | __NCHANNELS__ / 2 (RR, LL) |
| Nominal bandwidth | __NOMINAL_BANDWIDTH_MHZ__ MHz |
| Flag-adjusted equivalent bandwidth | __USABLE_BANDWIDTH_MHZ__ MHz |
| Imaging | Stokes I, natural, no taper, niter=0 |
| ECT-equivalent SEFD (correlation efficiency) | __SEFD_JY__ Jy (0.93) |
| Random seed | 20260907 |
| Reference | [NRAO VLA 2026A OSS sensitivity](__OSS_SOURCE__) |

The package default is 310 Jy at 6 GHz. This test uses 236.7 Jy (derived from
the calculator result at 7.291 GHz). The 8-bit, Zenith, and Winter settings are
test inputs (they were not recovered from the MS).

## Results

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---:|
| `simplenoise` (visibility sigma) | __SIMPLENOISE_JY__ Jy |
| Predicted image RMS (flags included) | __FLAGGED_RMS_JY__ Jy/beam |
| Central PB-region RMS | __CENTRAL_RMS_JY__ Jy/beam |
| Central PB-region scaled MAD | __CENTRAL_MAD_JY__ Jy/beam |

Status: **__STATUS__**

__FAILURES__

## External VLA Exposure Calculator check

Open <https://obs.vla.nrao.edu/ect> and fill the rows in order. Press Tab after
the frequency and bandwidth (this enables the other controls).

| Step | Calculator row | Enter or select |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Representative Frequency | `7291 MHz` (press Tab) |
| 2 | Frequency Bandwidth | `69.5725 MHz` (press Tab) |
| 3 | Purpose of Calculation | `Noise Simulation Check` |
| 4 | Array Configuration | `B` |
| 5 | Number of Antennas | `27` |
| 6 | Polarization Setup | `Dual` |
| 7 | Type of Image Weighting | `Natural` |
| 8 | Receiver Band | Output (`C`) |
| 9 | Approximate Beam Size | Output (about `1.318 arcsec`) |
| 10 | Number of Frequencies | `1` |
| 11 | Session Includes Pointing | `False` |
| 12 | Digital Samplers | `8 bit` |
| 13 | Elevation | `Zenith (90 degrees)` |
| 14 | Average Weather | `Winter` |
| 15 | Calculation Type | `Noise/Tb` |
| 16 | Number of Sources | `1` |
| 17 | Time on Source | `1175s` (or `19m35s`) |
| 18 | Total On-Source Time | Output (`19m35s`) |
| 19 | Total Time | Output (about `37m22s`) |
| 20 | Line Velocity Width | Output (about `__ECT_EXPECTED_LINE_WIDTH_KMS__ km/s`) |
| 21 | RMS Noise | Output (about **`__ECT_EXPECTED_RMS_MICROJY__ µJy/beam`**) |
| 22 | RMS Brightness | Output (about `__ECT_EXPECTED_TB_K__ K`) |
| 23 | Confusion Level | Output (ignore for this test) |
| 24 | Overhead Explanation | Output (not used) |

Compare RMS Noise with the central PB-region RMS above (not with the real-data
Pipeline RMS). Small rounding differences are normal.
